::: {.g-col-sm-6 .g-col-12 .title-block .text-block}

I'm a Master's student of Economics at Université [***Panthéon-Sorbonne***](https://economie.pantheonsorbonne.fr/) in Paris.

\

Topics I'm interested in: 

- (wealth) inequality
- development econ
- the history of economic thought

As a Carlo-Schmid-Fellow, I contributed to policy work at the [***United Nations***](https://policy.desa.un.org/). I've also worked at [***IWH***](https://www.iwh-halle.de/en/about-the-iwh/research-centres/centre-for-evidence-based-policy-advice) and [***IAMO***](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Leibniz_Institute_of_Agricultural_Development_in_Transition_Economies), and completed my undergrad in [***Halle***](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=w6sLH3PJNLA).
